text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the Japan Cup together 
with Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san...! To be here with the Teio-san 
I've always admired, truly...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you get too carried away walking on 
air, you'll trip yourself up, you know? 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There are Umamusume invited from abroad 
today. It's a race with many 
uncertainties, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who I'm up against, the great 
Teio will blow them all away!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I won't be brushed aside! I'm... I'm going 
to beat you, Teio-san!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! Kita-chan's fighting 
spirit hasn't backed down one bit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Kitasan!! Surpass your idol!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Surpass the "Emperor"! Our Kitasan can do 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Show them the majesty of the "Emperor"! 
Tokai Teio—!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the crowd's support is split 
about fifty-fifty...

"Both already had passionate fanbases. 
This year's Japan Cup is generating even 
more excitement than usual."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... Do your best—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And look at Tokai Teio! She slides 
smoothly up the field right here! She 
pulls up directly behind Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? She's moving early...! Normally, 
Teio-san would still be holding back at 
this point...!

Tokai Teio boldly sinks her teeth into 
Kitasan Black's lead.

This was a development that had rarely 
been seen from Tokai Teio up until now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kh... Ghaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is responding too... Wait, no. 
This is...!

Kitasan Black picked up speed momentarily 
when pressured, but gradually settled back 
into her own pace afterward.

A fierce battle of tactics unfolds between 
Tokai Teio and Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even though both Kita-chan and Teio-san 
have the advantage of having run the Japan 
Cup before...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Not only did she run her own race, but 
what an aggressive performance that 
was...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...With this kind of development, if it 
were me...

Satono Diamond fixes her gaze on the race, 
seemingly beginning to visualize the race 
development in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is stretching out her stride! 
Can Kitasan Black hold onto the lead, or 
will Tokai Teio chase her down—
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That really surprised me...! I never 
expected Teio-san to run so 
aggressively...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! If you play it safe, 
it's all over right then and there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I never forget the spirit of challenging 
myself. All so I can reach even greater 
heights!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So for the Arima Kinen, I'm going to 
challenge Dia-chan and Kita-chan as a 
challenger myself!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You'd better be ready!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To always keep that fighting spirit... 
That is Teio-san's way of being a 
"legendary Umamusume"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen as the defender accepting the 
challenge. Teio as the challenger taking 
it on.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (In that case, I...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The Satono family's very first GⅠ 
victory... A victory seized by challenging 
the jinx and overcoming it.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Chasing after Kita-chan led to this race 
on the grand stage of the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The way of being that is true to myself 
is...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

After a long silence, Satono Diamond 
finally spoke, her face marked with a look 
of fierce resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I intend to keep challenging myself from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have constantly taken on 
challenges. Such as the jinx plaguing the 
Satono family, and Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why, as a 'renowned Umamusume,' I 
believe continuing to take on all kinds of 
challenges is true to who I am.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just as challenging McQueen-san and 
Teio-san wrote a brand new page in the 
Satono family's history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on every challenge and 
carve out a new history for Satono and the 
entire Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I thought about that, it made me 
realize once more that I really want to 
take on overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not to show possibilities, but as my own 
desire.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to win a prestigious overseas race 
and etch the Satono name into Umamusume 
history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And pave the way for a new chapter in 
history for both House Satono and the 
world of Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is a way I can contribute 
to the Umamusume world.
choice_data_list: So you found the answer, huh.
So you found the answer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How Satono Diamond should be as a "great 
Umamusume"... The self I should strive to 
become is now set.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I shall win the Arima Kinen and join the 
ranks of the legendary Umamusume!
